behaviour: Adds member TSDoc to the apiVersion, kind and spec members of the ApiEntityV1alpha1 interface, clearing three (undocumented) markers.
rules: 1. Add exactly three comment blocks, one per site, each a multi-line block directly above the member it documents.
2. No release tag in any of the three blocks; the interface's own block with its @public stays byte-identical.
3. No @param and no @returns in a member block; a property is not a function.
4. Change no type, no literal, no member order and nothing below the interface (apiEntityV1alpha1Validator and apiEntityModel are untouched).
